children: Howmet Aerospace (HWM) shares fell on Monday after SpaceX said it plans to produce some gas-turbine components internally, prompting Citi to place the aerospace supplier on a 30-day upside catalyst watch.
The stock rebounded Tuesday as investors assessed the potential impact, while Bernstein separately maintained an Outperform rating and raised its target to $328.

The move centered on SpaceX's plan to cast turbine blades and vanes for a planned power project supporting AI data centers. Citi analyst John Godyn kept a Buy rating and said the development highlights the importance of Howmet's components and strong demand across the industrial gas-turbine market.

Citi sees limited near-term disruption from SpaceX's manufacturing plans. Growing electricity needs from AI data centers could also keep turbine demand elevated, potentially supporting Howmet's industrial business beyond its roughly $2 billion revenue objective.
For HWM stock, the development may create near-term volatility, but analyst commentary suggests AI-related power demand could continue supporting its turbine business.

title: Citi Says 'Buy the Dip' on Howmet Stock After SpaceX Turbine Move
